title: Middle Course of the Glaive Sweep
summary: Builds on the basic sweeps by letting qi follow the blade around the arc and clear a ring of attackers.

title: Treatise on Reverse Grip and Rear-Hand Slide
summary: Teaches changing grip and sliding the rear hand so reach and angle change without warning, with qi in the swap.

title: Guard and Turn: A Glaive Reader
summary: A short reader on the three guard lines of the glaive and on turning a held guard into a counter cut.

title: Qi in the Long Curved Blade
summary: Explains how qi travels down the shaft to the edge and how to time its arrival with the cut.

title: Glaive Against the Mounted Rider
summary: Teaches a footman to meet a charging rider with the glaive, cutting the horse, the leg and the saddle girth.

title: Practice of the Crescent Pull
summary: Drills the pulling cut and the ankle catch, in which the curve of the blade draws the foe off balance.

title: Footwork Canon for the Long Blade
summary: A canon of triangle steps, circling walks and long lunges that carry the glaive's reach into the foe.

title: Compendium of Glaive Shaft Work
summary: Gathers the shaft's uses, from rolling parries and hand-over-hand reach to qi-hardened strikes and whipping rebounds.

title: The Wheeling Glaive
summary: Teaches the continuous wheeling of the glaive as both attack and screen, with qi sustaining the spin.
